text: Which is bigger: 4,725 or 4,752? Start from the left, at the biggest house.
Thousands: four and four. They are the same.
Hundreds: seven and seven. Still the same.
Tens: two and five are different. Five is bigger than two!
So 4,725 is less than 4,752. Remember: the open mouth always faces the bigger number.
